lines.zh: 河水凉，我顺着石缝穿过去。
lines.en: The river is cool; I thread through the stones.

lines.zh: 三到五条，我们贴着河床走。
lines.en: Three to five of us glide along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我拐弯时几乎不激水花。
lines.en: I turn without raising a splash.

lines.zh: 前面那条停了，我们也停。
lines.en: The one ahead stops, and so do we.
No rush; the river flows on its own.
Colder water is where I swim best.
I hug the rocks and avoid the rapids.

lines.zh: 队伍排成一列，谁也不挤。
lines.en: We form a line, and nobody jostles.

lines.zh: 这块卵石，我昨天才擦过。
lines.en: I brushed this very pebble yesterday.
Spring floods come, and the road widens.
I turn a bend; my schoolmates follow.

lines.zh: 河底的卵石一颗颗数过去。
lines.en: I count the riverbed pebbles one by one.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我自己不费劲。
lines.en: The current pushes me with no effort of mine.
Autumn clears the water; I see farther.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块大石，队伍跟上。
lines.en: I round a big rock, and the school follows.
The water is cold, so I slow down.
I swish my tail and splash a little.
I pass through the shade under the bridge.

lines.zh: 我悬在石缝边，一动不动。
lines.en: I hover at the rock's edge, perfectly still.
Cool water passes my gills; it feels good.
My mouth is small, and so is my voice.
I count the leaves on the river: one.
There is a sound upstream; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 大口黑鲈是我亲戚，别提。
lines.en: The largemouth is my cousin; do not bring it up.

lines.zh: 我停在阴影里，水温刚好。
lines.en: I rest in the shade, where the water is right.

lines.zh: 四格宽的河，够我待一天。
lines.en: A river four blocks wide is enough for a day.
I keep my fins folded to save strength.
A crab is walking sideways down there.

lines.zh: 水清的时候，我喜欢看底。
lines.en: When the water is clear, I like watching the bottom.
I have only four health, so I am careful.

lines.zh: 有人在岸上洗手，我躲开。
lines.en: Someone washes hands on the bank; I move off.
Only a quiet river could have raised me.
You are on the bank; I am in cold water.
That rod in your hand has a line too thick.

lines.zh: 我抬头，水面把你的脸拉长。
lines.en: I look up; the surface stretches your face.
Do not step down; the bottom is all pebbles.

lines.zh: 你是秋季来的吧，我看得出。
lines.en: You came in autumn, I can tell.

lines.zh: 我们一族不爱被人盯着。
lines.en: My kind dislikes being stared at.
You come one step; I retreat half a block.
A small mouth is not a flaw but restraint.
Your reflection breaks apart in the ripples.
Look, then go; leave the net behind.
The blade passes and the water reddens.
Four health, and half is gone at once.
I dart into the crevice to hide.
My schoolmates scatter, swimming fast.

lines.zh: 伤口发凉，我咬着水不吭声。
lines.en: The cut runs cold; I bite the water silently.
Two of my scales have been shaved off.
That blow lands harder than the current.
I retreat upstream, using the current to hide.
Down to a sliver of health; I must go.

lines.zh: 水把血冲走，我看不见伤。
lines.en: Water washes the blood away; I cannot see the wound.

lines.zh: 钩上的虫子很小，正合我口。
lines.en: The bug on the hook is small, just my size.
I open my mouth, test it, then close.
The bait is alive and still wriggling.
In cold water, the smell travels slowly.
My schoolmate bites first; I watch.
The hook is too shiny, and I mind the shine.
Reel the line in a bit and I will follow.
I bite lightly; do not jerk hard.

lines.zh: 河底的食不多，这个算好。
lines.en: Food is scarce on the bottom; this counts as good.

lines.zh: 我嘴上说不，尾巴已经摇了。
lines.en: My mouth says no; my tail already twitches.

lines.zh: 你涉水过来，卵石全翻了。
lines.en: You wade in and turn every pebble over.

lines.zh: 你的膝弯撞过来，我侧身让。
lines.en: Your knee comes at me; I turn aside.
The school breaks apart for a moment.
That step of yours landed too hard.

lines.zh: 我被挤到石头后面去了。
lines.en: I get squeezed behind a stone.
The current stirs, and I retreat at once.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我，我们各自让开。
lines.en: A schoolmate bumps me; we each give way.
I am slender; hitting you will not hurt.
Mud churns up and I cannot see.
When the water clears, we move again.
Spring comes, and only then does she approach.
Two bass circle in the shallows.
Our nest lies under the pebbles.

lines.zh: 她比我小一圈，脾气不小。
lines.en: She is a size smaller, and no meeker.

lines.zh: 凉水才配得上这场相遇。
lines.en: Only cold water suits a meeting like this.
When summer ends, we will part.

lines.zh: 我守在水流上游，替她挡。
lines.en: I hold the upstream side and shield her.

lines.zh: 一小群孩子会跟着我们。
lines.en: A small brood will follow us around.
Stay quiet; sound carries far in water.
This season, I know only her.

lines.zh: 桶里的水是温的，我不习惯。
lines.en: The bucket water is warm; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 你把我舀起来，我贴在边上。
lines.en: You scoop me up and I press to the side.

lines.zh: 这里没有卵石，也没有凉意。
lines.en: No pebbles here, and no chill either.
Each sway bumps me into the wall.
I jump once and get nowhere.
Are you taking me to another river?
The bucket floor is slick; I cannot steady.
My schoolmates' sounds are fading.
This spot gets far too much sun.
Put me back; the river is waiting.

lines.zh: 水面有虫子落下，我看见。
lines.en: A bug falls on the surface; I see it.

lines.zh: 上游漂来一片叶，不是吃的。
lines.en: A leaf drifts down; not food.
Something turns over in the waterweed.

lines.zh: 同伴突然聚拢，我也过去。
lines.en: My schoolmates bunch up; I go too.
That shadow is wider than the crevice.
I turn my head and check the current first.
Footsteps on the bank, getting closer.

lines.zh: 我记住了那个晃动的点。
lines.en: I have marked that bobbing spot.
Bait hits the water with a soft sound.
This season, the food moves.
I lock on it, tail perfectly still.
In cold water, my aim is sure.
It shifts once, and I correct a little.
I do not charge; first I watch.
Two blocks out is room enough to sprint.
The target is by the weeds; I circle around.

lines.zh: 它悬在卵石上，我数着距离。
lines.en: It hangs over a pebble; I measure the gap.
I lower my body and wait for the current.
Marked it; do not let it slip.
This bite must be a clean one.
I bite down; small mouth, firm grip.
It thrashes twice, and I let go.
I rush in and raise a small splash.
I timed that one right.
Four points of effort, that is all I have.
It is smaller than I am; I regret it.

lines.zh: 我一口咬偏，只撕下一点鳍。
lines.en: My bite goes wide and takes only fin.
The splash clears, and it is gone.
Fighting is loud; water carries sound.
Enough; I do not want to bite again.

lines.zh: 我在河湾的凉水里出生。
lines.en: I was born in the cold water of a bend.

lines.zh: 春季的河，正好容下我们。
lines.en: A spring river has room for us.

lines.zh: 三到五条一起落进石缝。
lines.en: Three to five of us drop among the stones.
The water is clear; I can see bottom.
I remember the autumn water temperature.
I am quite common, and I do not mind.
The river sounds, and I wake.
We are regulars in this stretch.
Born in summer, grown by autumn.

lines.zh: 这里比我亲戚的池塘凉。
lines.en: This is colder than my cousin's pond.
The water boils, and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 被甩到岸上，我弹了两下。
lines.en: Flung onto the bank, I flop twice.

lines.zh: 我离开水太久，鳃在发干。
lines.en: Away from water too long, my gills dry.
The blast sounds muffled underwater.
An arrow enters the water and finds me.

lines.zh: 魔法让整条河都变冷了。
lines.en: Magic turns the whole river cold.
There is not enough food on this bottom.

lines.zh: 雷落在河面，整条河亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river and it all lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，也没有河。
lines.en: The void has no water and no river.
